## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
RISK-ON. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive; positive sectors: Industrials, Materials, Financials, Utilities, Consumer Disc., Technology (6/11). Confirmations: strong Industrials/Financials performance (CAT, GE, JPM ABOVE TREND) and sector breadth ≥5/11; leadership concentrated: Narrow (3/5 Technology in Top 5).

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Industrials lead: CAT (1W: +11.65% | 1M: +10.65%) ABOVE TREND, GE (1W: +12.02% | 1M: +24.84%) ABOVE TREND, BA (1W: +7.96% | 1M: +2.28%) ABOVE TREND. Financials strong: JPM (1W: +7.87% | 1M: +10.88%) ABOVE TREND, COF (1W: +13.08% | 1M: +7.78%) ABOVE TREND. Materials showing rotation: NEM (1W: +13.91% | 1M: -3.58%) RECOVERY.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Energy lagging: XOM (1W: -6.56% | 1M: -12.31%) BELOW TREND, CVX (1W: -6.44% | 1M: -8.62%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Staples weak: WMT (1W: -2.04% | 1M: -11.41%) BELOW TREND. Communication under pressure with META (1W: -0.50% | 1M: -7.05%) BELOW TREND and GOOGL (1W: +2.08% | 1M: -8.30%) RECOVERY.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: AMAT (1W: +19.30% | 1M: +43.54%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +16.36% | 1M: +34.71%) ABOVE TREND, VST (1W: +14.65% | 1M: +16.15%) ABOVE TREND, NEM (1W: +13.91% | 1M: -3.58%) RECOVERY, AMD (1W: +13.28% | 1M: +21.73%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Technology) — semicap/equipment names concentrated.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: ADBE (1W: -15.90% | 1M: -23.22%) BELOW TREND, NOW (1W: -9.98% | 1M: -7.68%) BELOW TREND, SLB (1W: -9.33% | 1M: -11.47%) BELOW TREND, COP (1W: -7.26% | 1M: -10.70%) BELOW TREND, PSX (1W: -8.01% | 1M: -7.02%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in Energy and select software names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Strongest 1W moves: AMAT (1W: +19.30% | 1M: +43.54%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +16.36% | 1M: +34.71%) ABOVE TREND, VST (1W: +14.65% | 1M: +16.15%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +13.28% | 1M: +21.73%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +13.14% | 1M: +11.95%) ABOVE TREND. Major divergence: large-cap tech trio AAPL (RECOVERY), NVDA (RECOVERY), GOOGL (RECOVERY) vs MSFT (BELOW TREND) — this is a MAJOR divergence; treat as tactical not broad confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Mixed: semicap and chip-equipment names leading — AMAT (1W: +19.30% | 1M: +43.54%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +16.36% | 1M: +34.71%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +13.28% | 1M: +21.73%) ABOVE TREND — while large software/AI names show stress: ADBE (1W: -15.90% | 1M: -23.22%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -4.64% | 1M: -10.34%) BELOW TREND. Technology sector 1W: +1.64% (24 stocks) — internal rotation from software to semicap.

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Strong and broad: JPM (1W: +7.87% | 1M: +10.88%) ABOVE TREND, COF (1W: +13.08% | 1M: +7.78%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +2.30% | 1M: -0.68%) RECOVERY. Financials 1W: +3.74% (20 stocks) — confirms cyclical/value tilt.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Mixed/defensive: JNJ (1W: -1.80% | 1M: +2.89%) CORRECTION, UNH (1W: -1.39% | 1M: +2.73%) CORRECTION, LLY (1W: -2.14% | 1M: +12.54%) CORRECTION, PFE (1W: +1.25% | 1M: +2.33%) ABOVE TREND. Healthcare 1W: -0.95% (17 stocks) — news-driven pockets (JNJ, GILD) amid short-term profit-taking.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor cyclicals/value: increase exposure to Industrials and Financials — CAT (1W: +11.65% | 1M: +10.65%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +7.87% | 1M: +10.88%) ABOVE TREND, GE (1W: +12.02% | 1M: +24.84%) ABOVE TREND. Reduce exposure to lagging Energy and pressured large-cap software names such as XOM (1W: -6.56% | 1M: -12.31%) BELOW TREND and ADBE (1W: -15.90% | 1M: -23.22%) BELOW TREND; style: Value/Cyclical over Growth.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: AMAT (1W: +19.30% | 1M: +43.54%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +16.36% | 1M: +34.71%) ABOVE TREND — watch for follow-through in semicap cycle. BEARISH: ADBE (1W: -15.90% | 1M: -23.22%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -4.64% | 1M: -10.34%) BELOW TREND — watch for further downside if weekly weakness persists.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Industrials (1W: +5.82% | 1M: +6.49%) and Financials (1W: +3.74% | 1M: +5.33%) — both confirming RISK-ON. BEARISH: Energy (1W: -6.45% | 1M: -8.75%) and Communication (1W: -1.31% | 1M: -5.50%) — watch earnings/news risk and patent/legal headlines.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
NVDA (1W: +2.11% | 1M: -7.84%) RECOVERY — trigger: sustained move that flips 1M to positive for broader participation. AAPL (1W: +1.50% | 1M: -0.63%) RECOVERY — trigger: weekly follow-through to confirm reversal. JPM (1W: +7.87% | 1M: +10.88%) ABOVE TREND — trigger: continuation of weekly strength to validate financial leadership.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
JNJ (+80): JNJ (1W: -1.80% | 1M: +2.89%) CORRECTION — Phase 3 myeloma win; sentiment is bullish but short-term price is in correction (news/price divergence). VST (+65): VST (1W: +14.65% | 1M: +16.15%) ABOVE TREND — Vistra bullish news confirming price acceleration. CAT (+55): CAT (1W: +11.65% | 1M: +10.65%) ABOVE TREND — upbeat AI backlog commentary confirms strength.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
ADBE (-50): ADBE (1W: -15.90% | 1M: -23.22%) BELOW TREND — negative headlines align with sharp price weakness (sentiment confirmed). ACN (-40): ACN (1W: -8.50% | 1M: -12.13%) BELOW TREND — bearish commentary and price decline are aligned; monitor for further downside.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON, Value/Cyclical style; Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive.  
Industrial and financial leaders showing strength: CAT (1W: +11.65% | 1M: +10.65%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +19.30% | 1M: +43.54%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +7.87% | 1M: +10.88%) ABOVE TREND.  
Key risk: Major divergence among large-cap tech (AAPL, NVDA, GOOGL in RECOVERY vs MSFT and ADBE BELOW TREND) and select news-driven gaps (JNJ bullish news diverging from short-term weakness) — watch for confirmation before reallocating core exposure.
